mapper.select: SELECT budget.id, budget.month_value, budget.category, budget.amount, COALESCE(SUM(ledger.amount), 0) AS spent FROM mf_finance_budget budget LEFT JOIN mf_finance_transaction ledger ON ledger.user_id = budget.user_id AND ledger.category = budget.category AND ledger.transaction_type = '支出' AND ledger.transaction_date >= #{start} AND ledger.transaction_date <= #{end} WHERE budget.user_id = #{userId} AND budget.month_value = #{month} GROUP BY budget.id, budget.month_value, budget.category, budget.amount ORDER BY budget.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mf_finance_budget (user_id, month_value, category, amount) VALUES (#{entity.userId}, #{entity.monthValue}, #{entity.category}, #{entity.amount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE amount = VALUES(amount), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mf_finance_budget WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
